description: Branch R-SORT-3 Length510 boundary and Shortened-key collisions on a ACCDB, public side, one character kind per probe (this one: U+00E9), eight lengths from 100 to 255 units. LA(K Text(255), N Long) with non-unique IX_KN on (K, N) built before the rows: per length the row N = 2 is inserted before N = 1 (IDs base+1 and base+2), so a key that keeps N orders base+2 first and a key cut before N orders by row position. LB has unique UX_KN on (K, N): N = 2, N = 1, then a true duplicate of N = 1 (the control that must be refused). LC has unique UX_K on K: K1 = unit x (length-1) + 'x', K2 = the same + 'y', K3 = 'y' + unit x (length-1) (a change at the first position), and a true duplicate of K1; every refusal read with a marked Errors. LD has the same rows as LC under a non-unique index, and SQL equality pairs are read. The IX_KN, UX_KN and UX_K walks and SQL ORDER BY K, N are read. Asks the length at which N stops deciding order, whether a changed last character still gives a distinct key, and whether SQL equality still separates the rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE LA (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_LA PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255), N LONG)
CREATE INDEX IX_KN ON LA (K, N)
CREATE TABLE LB (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_LB PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255), N LONG)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_KN ON LB (K, N)
CREATE TABLE LC (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_LC PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_K ON LC (K)
CREATE TABLE LD (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_LD PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255))
SELECT ID FROM LA ORDER BY K, N
SELECT A.ID, B.ID FROM LD AS A INNER JOIN LD AS B ON A.K = B.K WHERE A.ID < B.ID
SELECT A.ID, B.ID FROM LD AS A INNER JOIN LD AS B ON A.K < B.K WHERE A.ID + 1 = B.ID
